summary: A repaired, staged proposal for a fail-closed offline selected-continuation writer/interface floor. It preserves Fable’s exploratory evidence while preventing source-oracle leakage, bootstrap copying, premature tokenizer/GPU work, target exposure, writeback, and broader organism attribution.
system_thesis: The organism’s thesis distinguishes lived action/outcome episodes; dream-time local connection growth and memory re-expression; parametric consolidation/transport; goal-conditioned retrieval, composition, planning, and revision; and later feedback into subsequent dream cycles. This proposal exercises only a quarantined fragment: historical episode traces are post-hoc selected by source outcome oracles, then transported through an assay-local LoRA into a one-decision strict action writer. It does not exercise retrieval, compositional planning, revision, recurrent dream-memory-think loops, or feedback from outcomes into later dreams. Any behavioral result belongs to the complete selected-corpus-plus-writer assay, not to a LoRA as discoverer and not to the complete organism.
